subject: Request: Senior signoff for 22.5% Hosted API concession for AuroraAI pilot
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 08 May 2027 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: AuroraAI pilot pricing ask — asking for senior signoff

Forwarding the customer ask below — they are pushing for a 22.5% concession on Hosted API unit pricing for a 6-month pilot with a potential enterprise roll after Q3. They attached their procurement appendix and a usage forecast (see attachments).

Quick summary: AuroraAI is a strategic prospect (healthcare analytics startup, series B) with a strong product-market fit. They want a short-term pilot (6 months) with a committed monthly minimum of 750k tokens but expect heavy bursts during model retraining windows. Their legal team wants the concession locked into Appendix A. They asked whether we can match the requested effective rate today to accelerate procurement.

Economic impact: at 22.5% off our standard hosted usage tier, the unit margin compresses below our preferred pilot threshold; however, the attached forecast shows a realistic path to >$80k ARR if conversion goes well.

Can you review and advise on senior signoff? If we proceed, proposed constraints: 90-day capped concession, non-recurring pilot rate in Appendix A (explicit expiration), and a requirement for 45-day review and usage telemetry access through our Console.

Attachments: Aurora_MA_Appendix_A.pdf, aurora_usage_forecast_q3.xlsx

— Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Lena Park <lena.park@auroraai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@auroraai.com>, procurement@auroraai.com
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pilot pricing proposal

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — our engineers were impressed with Redwood's latency profile and the KV caching suggestions. We're ready to move to a pilot but need a short-term commercial alignment in order to get procurement approved. Our procurement team is requesting a 22.5% concession on Hosted API usage rates for the 6-month pilot (Appendix A attached).

Why this matters: our CFO needs predictable unit economics for the pilot to justify the integration work and the associated implementation SOW. If Redwood can sign that concession into Appendix A and provide basic usage dashboards access, we can fast-track PO issuance within two weeks.

We appreciate the flexibility and are open to a limited-time concession tied to telemetry and a success review.

Best,
Lena Park
Head of Partnerships | AuroraAI
Lena.Park@auroraai.com

-----Original Attachment: Aurora_MA_Appendix_A.pdf (PDF, 252 KB)
-----Original Attachment: aurora_usage_forecast_q3.xlsx (XLSX, 84 KB)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 08 May 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Requesting senior clearance: 22.5% Hosted API concession for AuroraAI pilot — recommendation included

Marcus —

Looping you in for senior clearance. Ben routed Aurora's procurement appendix requesting a 22.5% off our standard Hosted API usage rate for a 6-month pilot. I reviewed the forecast and the strategic value: AuroraAI is building in healthcare analytics (APAC expansion potential) and could become a large annualized customer if the pilot converts.

My recommended approach if we approve:
- Approve a 22.5% concession for a strictly time-bound pilot (90 days effective; the appendix should automatically revert to standard rates after 90 days).
- Require a minimum monthly consumption commitment of 750k tokens (else concession void).
- Include an explicit telemetry clause permitting access to per-route token and latency metrics for the review period.
- Add a carve-out: concession only applies to the Pilot SKU (no effect on Dedicated or Private offers).
- Finance sign-off required for revenue recognition terms (cc Mina).

Rationale: it shortens procurement cycle substantially and gets us into production with a customer likely to expand. Risks: the concession compresses unit economics for the pilot window; we should gate it on telemetry and a very short automatic expiration to avoid precedent.

If approved, Ben will lock changes into Appendix A and coordinate with Legal on the limited-term language.

Can you sign off (or propose an alternative) by EOD Sunday so we can move quickly?

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Manager, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0789

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requesting senior clearance: 22.5% Hosted API concession for AuroraAI pilot — recommendation included

Thanks for the clear summary, Tessa. I approve the 22.5% concession on the conditions you outlined. Please ensure Legal adds both: (1) an explicit 90-day expiration on Appendix A and (2) a minimum monthly consumption clause of 750k tokens tied to the concession. Also require a written telemetry access agreement (read-only Console reports) for the review window.

Finance (Mina) — please confirm the accounting treatment for the concession and whether we need to mark the pilot as a promotional credit that affects ARR reporting. If finance requires a reserve entry, note that this will be limited to the 90-day window per Legal language.

Ben — please push the revised Appendix A into the DocuSign envelope and flag procurement that the concession is time-bound; get signature and PO within two weeks. If procurement asks for a longer term, come back to me directly.

Granting this exception given the strategic runway and likely expansion — but keep tight controls.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199
